commentary.text: 90+10' Isidro Diaz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+8' David Lopez (Girona) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the bottom left corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Augusto Batalla, who pulls off a stunning save!
90+7' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

90+6' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the middle of the goal. Augusto Batalla is alert, though, and makes an easy save to deny him.
90+5' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
90+4' The fouls committed statistics – 18:6.
90+2' Randy Nteka (Rayo Vallecano) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Isidro Diaz had an easy-decision to make.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' Ivan Balliu (Rayo Vallecano) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jorge de Frutos.
86' Juanpe (Girona) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot.

10' Arnaut Danjuma (Girona) has a goal ruled out for offside!

5' A fine pass finds Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Paulo Gazzaniga reacts superbly to deny him.
4' Rayo Vallecano players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
